description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mikaeus triggers, returning Skirk Prospector from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Skirk Prospector from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
